system.description:
Inanimate matter crumbles beneath the sorcerer's touch, dead organic material melting into a puddle of putrescence as the years race by in moments.

No test is necessary. For each turn you maintain contact with an object, it ages a full year, quickly rotting wood or organic matter and, given time, weakening even metal or plastic. Break contact and the aging ceases, but any decay inflicted is permanent. Aging the flesh of a vampire has no functional effect, as their preserved corpses are immune. Casting takes a single turn. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
